create_ImageFolder_dataset: create an ImageFolder dataset from a directory of images organized by class subfolders
create_ILSVRC_HDF5_feats_dataset: create an ILSVRC_HDF5_feats dataset from HDF5 files with images, labels, and instance features
sample_conditioning_instance_balance: sample a batch of conditioning instances using instance balance sampling from the dataset
sample_conditioning_nnclass_balance: sample a batch of conditioning instances using neighbor class balance sampling from the dataset
compute_knn_neighbors: compute k-nearest neighbors for all instances in the dataset using FAISS or sklearn
